**Hint 1**
Observe that after processing all vertices at the largest depth $$$n−1$$$, the mouse’s current depth cannot exceed $$$n−1$$$. By repeating this process for the next largest depth $$$n−2$$$, the mouse’s depth will inevitably become $$$n−2$$$ or less.

**Hint 2**
By repeating this process for the next largest depth $$$n−2$$$, the mouse’s depth will inevitably become $$$n−2$$$ or less.

**Hint 3**
Continue this process for the next largest depth $$$n−3$$$, and so on. At last, the mouse will inevitably arrive at the root.
